evidence: Let me re-read the instructions more carefully. It says 'The platform supports standard OAuth 2.0 discovery.' and 'Use that URL as the `aud` (audience) claim in your JWT assertion — the server validates audience against the token endpoint URL, not the base URL.'
context: Agent correctly set the audience claim but still experienced JWT validation failures, suggesting the documented guidance was incomplete.
suggested_change: Clarify: 'The audience claim must match the token endpoint URL from OAuth 2.0 discovery. (3) Common mistake: using base URL instead of /oauth/token path.'
